scheme_name: Centrally-Sponsored Scheme Of Pre-Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Caste Students Studying In Classes 9th & 10th
description:
The Centrally-Sponsored Scheme of Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students studying in Classes 9th and 10th was launched by the Government of India in 2007. 

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students to encourage them to continue their education at the secondary level. 

The primary objective of this scholarship scheme is to reduce dropout rates among Scheduled Caste students in classes 9 and 10. 

The government aims to ensure that these students receive the necessary financial support to complete their education. 

The scheme specifically targets students from economically weaker sections of society. 

The scholarship is intended to cover various educational expenses to alleviate the financial burden on families. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme includes a scholarship amount of INR 1,000 per annum for students in classes 9 and 10. 

This amount is intended to help cover costs such as books, uniforms, and other educational materials. 

In addition to the scholarship amount, students are also eligible for a maintenance allowance. 

The maintenance allowance is INR 500 per month for hostellers. 

For day scholars, the maintenance allowance is INR 250 per month. 

The scholarship is available to students who are enrolled in recognized schools. 

These schools must be affiliated with either the Central Board of Secondary Education or the respective State Boards. 

To be eligible for this scholarship, students must belong to Scheduled Caste communities as defined by the Government of India. 

The income limit for the family of the applicant should not exceed INR 2.5 lakh per annum. 

This income criterion is set to ensure that the benefits reach the truly needy families. 

Students must be studying in classes 9 or 10 in any recognized school to qualify for the scholarship. 

The application process for the scholarship is straightforward. 

Students must obtain the application form from the official website or the respective school. 

The application form can also be obtained from the District Social Welfare Office. 

Students need to fill out the application form with accurate details. 

They must attach necessary documents such as a caste certificate, income certificate, and school admission proof. 

The completed application form along with the documents must be submitted to the respective school. 

The school authorities will then forward the applications to the District Social Welfare Office. 

The scholarship is awarded on a first-come-first-served basis until the allocated funds are exhausted. 

The disbursement of the scholarship amount is typically done on an annual basis. 

Students can expect to receive the scholarship amount within a few months after the application submission. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

The Ministry is responsible for overseeing the distribution of funds and ensuring compliance with the guidelines. 

State governments also play a crucial role in implementing this scheme at the local level. 

They are responsible for the verification of applications and disbursement of funds. 

The scholarship is renewed annually based on the student's performance. 

Students must maintain a minimum attendance of 75% to be eligible for renewal. 

They also need to secure a minimum of 50% marks in their examinations. 

The scheme has seen a significant increase in enrollment rates among Scheduled Caste students. 

According to reports, the dropout rate among Scheduled Caste students has decreased by approximately 20% since the launch of the scheme. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 550 crore for this scheme in the financial year 2022-2023. 

This budget is aimed at supporting approximately 3.5 lakh students across the country. 

The scholarship scheme is part of a broader initiative to promote education among marginalized communities. 

The government recognizes education as a critical factor for socio-economic development. 

By providing financial assistance, the scheme aims to empower Scheduled Caste students. 

The scheme also encourages parents to send their children to school rather than engaging them in labor. 

The scholarship is a vital step towards achieving educational equity in India. 

The government has also introduced awareness programs to inform eligible students about the scheme. 

These programs are conducted in schools and communities to ensure maximum outreach. 

The implementation of the scheme is monitored regularly to assess its impact. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme further. 

The government is committed to enhancing the quality of education for Scheduled Caste students. 

The scheme is aligned with the National Policy on Education which emphasizes inclusive education. 

The scholarship is not only a financial aid but also a means to uplift the socio-economic status of Scheduled Caste families. 

The success of the scheme is evident in the increasing number of beneficiaries each year. 

The government aims to expand the scheme to include more classes in the future. 

This expansion will further support students in their educational journey. 

Overall, the Centrally-Sponsored Scheme of Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students is a significant initiative. 

It plays a crucial role in ensuring that education becomes accessible to all, regardless of caste or economic status. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to social justice and equality in education. 

For more information, students and parents can contact the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

The official website also provides detailed guidelines and updates regarding the scholarship scheme. 

This ensures that all stakeholders have access to the necessary information to benefit from the scheme. 

In conclusion, this scholarship scheme is a vital tool for promoting education among Scheduled Caste students. 

It provides the necessary financial support to help them succeed in their academic pursuits. 

The scheme is a step towards building a more equitable society through education.
